address_find: Find UK addresses from free text: an address, a postcode or a place name. Returns matching addresses with their UPRN, which every property tool takes. Costs 2 tokens.
address_postcode: List every registered address at a UK postcode, with the UPRN for each one. Costs 2 tokens.
amenities_all: Every amenity group near a property in one response: food, education, healthcare, financial, civic, worship, culture, convenience, green spaces, transport and shops. Costs 5 tokens.
amenities_civic: Civic places near a property: post offices, town halls, courthouses, fire and police stations, community centres. Costs 1 token.
amenities_convenience: Everyday conveniences near a property: public toilets, charging points, parcel lockers and similar. Costs 1 token.
amenities_culture: Culture and leisure near a property: theatres, cinemas, music venues, museums, galleries and attractions. Costs 1 token.
amenities_education: Education near a property: schools, nurseries, colleges, universities, childcare and libraries. For Ofsted ratings and pupil numbers use schools. Costs 1 token.
amenities_financial: Banks, cash machines and money services near a property. Costs 1 token.
amenities_food: Places to eat and drink near a property: cafes, restaurants, pubs, bars, takeaways. Costs 1 token.
amenities_green_spaces: Green space near a property: parks, playgrounds, gardens, nature reserves, commons and sports pitches. Costs 1 token.
amenities_healthcare: Health services near a property as mapped locally: doctors, dentists, clinics, hospitals, pharmacies and care homes. For regulator-registered records use healthcare_all and its per-type tools. Costs 1 token.
amenities_shops: Shops near a property, from supermarkets to specialist retailers. Costs 1 token.
amenities_transport: Transport stops near a property: bus stops, railway stations, tram stops and ferry terminals. Costs 1 token.
amenities_worship: Places of worship near a property. Costs 1 token.
attr_construction: How a property was built: construction age band, main construction material, and whether it has a basement. Costs 1 token.
attr_dimensions: Measurements for a property: footprint area in square metres, building height, estimated volume and predicted floor area. Costs 1 token.
attr_epc: Energy Performance Certificate headline for a property: current and potential efficiency rating, EPC floor area and the date of the last assessment. Costs 1 token.
attr_epc_renovations: Improvements recommended by a property's EPC assessment, each with estimated minimum and maximum cost. Costs 1 token.
attr_garden: Whether a property has a garden, and of what kind. Costs 1 token.
attr_land: Plot size in square metres for a property. Houses only: flats and maisonettes have no plot, and those return an error with nothing charged. Costs 1 token.
attr_parking: Whether a property has parking, and of what kind: driveway, off-street, garage and so on. Costs 1 token.
attr_roof: A property's roof: material, shape, and whether solar panels are fitted. Costs 1 token.
attr_rooms: Room counts for a property: bedrooms, bathrooms, habitable rooms and heated rooms. Costs 1 token.
boundaries: Search UK administrative areas by name and get their boundary id, for tools that take one. Costs 1 token.
broadband: Broadband availability at a postcode: average and maximum download and upload speeds, superfast, ultrafast, gigabit and full-fibre coverage, and how many premises are covered. From Ofcom Connected Nations. Costs 1 token.
calc_mortgage: Work out a mortgage from price, deposit, rate and term: monthly payment, total repayment, total interest, and loan-to-value and loan-to-income ratios. Free: no tokens spent, and no API key needed.
calc_stamp_duty: Work out Stamp Duty Land Tax for England and Northern Ireland: total tax, effective rate and a band-by-band breakdown, for a main residence, a first-time buyer or an additional property. Free: no tokens spent, and no API key needed.
council_tax: Council tax band for a property, with the billing authority name and its official code. For the yearly and monthly charge in pounds, use council_tax_full instead. Costs 3 tokens.
council_tax_full: The full council tax record for a property: band, billing authority and its official code, this year's yearly and monthly charge in pounds, the 1991 valuation bounds behind the band, and the fiscal year. Costs 5 tokens.
crime: Recorded crime near a postcode or coordinates, by category and month, from Police UK. Costs 1 token.
demographics: Census 2021 profile for the area around a postcode: population, tenure, age bands, ethnicity, occupation, household size and car ownership, plus deprivation where available. Costs 1 token.
deprivation: Index of Multiple Deprivation scores for a postcode, across income, employment, education, health, crime, housing and environment. England only. Costs 1 token.
fuel_stations_all: Petrol stations and EV charging points near a property, each tagged with which it is. Costs 1 token.
fuel_stations_ev: EV charging points near a property. Costs 1 token.
fuel_stations_petrol: Petrol stations near a property. Costs 1 token.
healthcare_all: Health services near a property: regulator-registered GPs, dentists and hospitals, plus pharmacies. Registered entries carry name, address, postcode, region, distance and a link to the official register record. Registered records cover England. Costs 3 tokens.
healthcare_dentists: Registered dental practices near a property, with name, address, postcode, region, distance and a link to the official register record. England only. Costs 1 token.
healthcare_gps: Registered GP practices near a property, with name, address, postcode, region, distance and a link to the official register record. England only. Costs 1 token.
healthcare_hospitals: Registered hospitals near a property, with name, address, postcode, region, distance and a link to the official register record. England only. Costs 1 token.
healthcare_pharmacies: Pharmacies near a property, with name, address, phone and website where known. Costs 1 token.
listed_buildings: Listed buildings within a radius of a postcode: Grade I, II* and II entries with name, location, listing date and a link to the official record. Costs 3 tokens.
planning: Planning applications near a postcode or coordinates: type, status, description and decision date, with filters for recency, type and status. Costs 5 tokens.
postcode_profile: One-call summary of a postcode: deprivation, crime, average property price, nearby schools, transport and broadband. Cheaper than calling those tools separately. The first call for a postcode is slow, because the parts are gathered and combined when you ask for them; the result is then cached, so asking again for the same postcode is fast. Wait for the first call rather than retrying it — retrying abandons the work already in progress and starts it over. Costs 1 token.
price_distributions: How property prices are spread across an outcode area: percentiles, median and transaction counts by property type. Costs 1 token.
price_growth: Capital growth for an outcode area: annual growth rate, returns over one, three, five and ten years, and a historical price index, from Land Registry sold prices. Costs 1 token.
price_trends: Average property prices over time for an outcode area. Costs 1 token.
property_address: Address-only record for a property: full address, postcode, coordinates and the standard address identifiers. The cheapest property tier, for address verification, form pre-fill and matching. Costs 5 tokens.
property_base: The house-hunter view of a property: address, rooms, EPC rating, last sale, construction, dimensions, garden, parking and title basics, in one call. Costs 10 tokens.
property_complete: Everything held on a property in one call: the Core record plus the full council tax charge, full title, environmental risks, deprivation, planning history and area price trends. Costs 50 tokens.
property_core: The full listing view of a property: everything in Base plus council tax band, flood risk, schools, broadband, crime, demographics, solar potential, confirmed sales and planning constraints. The usual starting point. Costs 25 tokens.
property_custom: Build your own property record: the base record plus only the add-ons you ask for, so you pay for exactly what you use. Call property_discovery first to see which add-ons a property has. Costs 1 token plus the price of each add-on requested.
property_discovery: The cheap first call for a property: which data is available for it, what each add-on costs, and the shortcuts to each tier. Also the quickest way to check whether a UPRN is one we hold. Costs 1 token.
property_lr_titles: Land Registry title records for a property: tenure, title number and registered owner where held. Costs 10 tokens.
risks: Environmental risk screening for a property: flood, radon, noise, landfill, coal and other mining, invasive plants and air quality. Ask for one hazard, or for all of them in a single response. Costs 1 token; 5 tokens when risk_type is all.
schools: Schools near a postcode, with Ofsted rating, phase, pupil numbers and distance, from the Department for Education register. England only. Costs 1 token.
solar: Solar potential for a property: usable roof area, estimated yearly generation, savings, payback period and carbon saved. Costs 5 tokens.
start_homedata_signup: Get a Homedata API key so the property data tools can be used: returns the sign-up link and the steps to follow. Makes no API call.
check_homedata_api_key: Check whether this server has a Homedata API key configured and what to do next if it has not. Makes no API call, so it never spends anything.
